sentence: This project tests drugs that fight viruses, using live virus in cell and animal models.
This project compares a safety planning tool for suicide prevention, used alone or with digital peer support, in young adults with recent suicidal ideation.
This project studies what makes end-of-life hospice care better for Veterans in community nursing homes.
This project uses a magnetically levitated device to study how shear flow affects blood cells.
This project studies how cellular proteins help human papillomaviruses travel to the nucleus during infection.
This project studies cilia and the diseases linked to defects in cilia.
This project studies how a vector genome used in gene therapy gets silenced in mice with human liver cells.
This project builds artificial cell interfaces to find out how fibroblast and T cell signaling works.
This project updates a bank of cancer tissue from responders and links it to medical records and blood samples.
This project builds an imaging system that uses infrared spectroscopic imaging and machine learning to judge the risk of oral precancer.
This project tests a mobile health tool that uses blood spectroscopy to find school-age children most likely to need malaria testing and treatment.
This project develops a small molecule inhibitor in a nanoparticle that makes colorectal cancer cells more sensitive to cell death.
This project studies how metformin acts in the brain and affects behaviors related to cocaine.
This project builds informatics tools to study the harmful proteins that alternative splicing produces in cancer.
This project studies how a signaling molecule helps carry fatty acids across blood vessels to support tumor metastasis.
This project studies the genetic and molecular basis of resistance to piperaquine, a malaria drug, in Plasmodium falciparum parasites.
This project studies how manganese causes neurotoxicity through impaired autophagy in Parkinson's disease.
This project uses transgenic mice to study how cellular senescence leads to vascular dysfunction in obstructive sleep apnea.
This project studies how thoughts, memories, feelings and actions arise from activity in the brain and change over time.
